commit.message:
feat(motion): Bore gets a Helical strategy (one helix to the floor, then a floor circle)

A Bore operation can now cut each hole with one continuous helix on the
wall radius (the ring ladder's last ring) from the plunge height to the
floor, one flat floor circle, an optional spring pass, then a feed to the
centre and a retract. The pitch is the stepdown. There is no axial plunge.

Two refusals run before any move: a hole one helix cannot clear to the
centre (the message gives the core and the widest hole, twice the tool
diameter for a flat end mill), and a helix steeper than 15 deg (the
message gives the pitch that fits). Detect holes skips and names the
holes one helix cannot clear for a helical Bore.

The project file writes `helical` and `spring_pass` only when true, so a
ring ladder writes the same JSON and keeps its stamp. MCP lists the two
fields. The Holes page gets a Strategy combo and a Spring pass check.

Fixes #2830

fix(motion): a helical bore refuses a helix inside the uncut core

A cutter that is not centre-cutting has an uncut core of
plunge_law::CORE of its radius. The helix cuts the hole axis only while
its wall circle stands at least that far off it; a smaller hole is now
refused by name with the smallest hole the cutter helixes. A centre-
cutting tool keeps the small helix.

The merge of main brought Pass starts at to Bore (#3360). One helix
per hole has no ring order: Inside and Outside are refused by name at
the command and in the generator, and the Passes tab says so.

Refs #2830

tab (main's Entry group, then the helix hint and refusal line), and the

or Helix entry by name (helical_entry_refusal), at the command and in
bore_started. Plunge, the default, keeps the helix.

Hand edit: sane.rs had two OpParams::Bore arms after the merge, and
main's entry arm hid the pass-start refusal of this branch. They are
one arm now. Missing fields: strategy in bore_ramp_angle.rs (main),
entry in bore_helical.rs (this branch).
